My Lesson Buddy browser prototype

Transformers.js 3.8.1 — Hugging Face — Apache License 2.0
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
ONNX Runtime Web — Microsoft — MIT License
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
fflate 0.8.3 — 101arrowz — MIT License
https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate

The optional model is HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct, revision
7e3e67edbbed1bf9888184d9df282b700a323964, Apache License 2.0.
Model weights are downloaded from Hugging Face by the visitor, not bundled here.
https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM-256M-Instruct

The optional character-description model is Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — Alibaba Qwen —
Apache License 2.0, using the onnx-community/Qwen3-0.6B-ONNX conversion,
revision 79346d370dfae34801d26993fda9ae2372900fd0, q4f16 weights.
The visitor downloads the weights and tokenizer; they are not bundled here.
https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Qwen3-0.6B-ONNX

Optional drawing restoration: Swin2SR lightweight 2x — Conde et al. / mv-lab,
Apache License 2.0. Uses Xenova/swin2SR-lightweight-x2-64 ONNX conversion,
revision 92a21aca5713f20faf9a87590cdfbdce2e34112c, fp32 weights.
Weights are downloaded by the visitor, not bundled in the website.
https://huggingface.co/caidas/swin2SR-lightweight-x2-64
https://huggingface.co/Xenova/swin2SR-lightweight-x2-64
https://github.com/mv-lab/swin2sr

Optional local companion (weights not distributed with the website):
DreamShaper 8 — Lykon — CreativeML Open RAIL-M, revision
a7e52b98680b1ba8ff7bce97c7f9f2e2e5337917. Includes its pretrained safety checker.
https://huggingface.co/Lykon/dreamshaper-8
ControlNet v1.1 Canny — lllyasviel — OpenRAIL, revision
115a470d547982438f70198e353a921996e2e819.
https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/control_v11p_sd15_canny
Diffusers — Hugging Face — Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers

Character parts and lesson illustrations are original project artwork.
Narration assets were generated locally for this project; no paid speech API is used.

Neural narration uses Kokoro-82M v1.0 — hexgrad — Apache License 2.0.
https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M
Model-card training-data attributions:
https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M#creative-commons-attribution
Build-time ONNX adapter: kokoro-onnx 0.6.1 — thewh1teagle — MIT License.
https://github.com/thewh1teagle/kokoro-onnx
The pretrained voice af_heart is used; no person's voice is cloned or uploaded.
Model weights and inference dependencies are not distributed with the website.
